verdict.rationale: mise is itself an official CLI with a full command reference at /cli/, covering exec, use, run, bootstrap and more. It has automation-friendly features such as `-C/--cd`, `--dry-run` previews, `--missing` exit codes, `--json` output on `mise lock`, plus an llms.txt and a `mise mcp` mode for agents. Community users corroborate daily CLI use. Missing for 10: evidence that structured/JSON output is available across commands beyond the single `mise lock --json` example.
